posts.title: A Tour of BeanCMS
posts.description: # A Tour of BeanCMS BeanCMS is a minimalist content management system. I built it as a personal replacement for the great rwtxt . The motivation to build BeanCMS was: I wanted to self-host rwtxt, but had some changes I wanted to make to the core application.
